description: Source code for the BasketService class implementing basket-related operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, updating quantities, and transferring baskets between users within the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Service class that manages basket operations such as adding items, deleting, updating quantities, and transferring baskets for users.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket for a specified user, creating a new basket if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID after ensuring its existence.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates quantities of items in a basket, returning a result indicating success or not found.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers items from an anonymous basket to a registered user's basket and deletes the anonymous basket.
